title.en: Memory, swap and the OOM killer

concept.hr: Predmemorija se vraća, odlagalište daje mjesta, a OOM ubija najveći zbroj
concept.en: Page cache gives way, swap buys room, the OOM killer takes the top score

summary.hr: Pokreni backup, bazu i build na stroju iz knjige: slobodno pada, raspoloživo ne; s odlagalištem svi prežive, bez njega ubojica OOM bira žrtvu.
summary.en: Start a backup, a database and a build on the book's machine: free drops, available holds; with swap all survive, without it the OOM killer picks a victim.

title.hr: Slobodno 0, a stroj nije bez memorije
title.en: Free is 0, and the machine is not out of memory

concept.hr: Predmemorija stranica se vraća: gleda se raspoloživo, ne slobodno
concept.en: Page cache is given back: read available, not free

title.en: The OOM killer kills the database

concept.hr: Umire proces s najvećim zbrojem, ne onaj koji je tražio
concept.en: The highest score dies, not the process that asked

concept.hr: Stranice baze odlaze u odlagalište i nitko ne umire
concept.en: The database's pages go to swap and nobody dies
